title: Grovey by the Sea
meta_description: Grovey By The Sea is a 4BR, 3BA oceanfront home in Seagrove with private beach access, gulf views, balcony, seasonal setup, and single-level layout.
description_expanded:
\*\*\*GULF FRONT, OCEAN VIEWS\*\*\*PRIVATE BEACH!

ABOUT THE HOME: This is Grovey By The Sea; a luxurious ocean front home with gulf views in the heart of 30A's Seagrove community. From the moment you walk through the door you are drawn into the home's elegance and stunning views of the sea. Stepping out onto the expansive balcony, you could get lost in thought just listening to the waves come ashore and letting the ocean breeze erase your stress. But you can savor that later after your day in sun and surf which are just steps away at your private beach. This property comes with seasonal beach service chairs service and set up (2 chairs, 1 umbrella Mar - Oct).

Grovey By The Sea is designed for multigenerational gatherings with a single-story living space. The open concept living space allows everyone to spread out yet stay connected while you dine and relax together. The cozy sofa and fireplace in the living room will be just the spot to watch a movie or your favorite team. And there are four king bedrooms and a sleeper sofa to comfortably sleep ten.

ABOUT AREA: Seagrove Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Seaside Beach and Seacrest Beach. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm with many options for recreation as well as dining. Eastern Lake and Deer Lakes provide wonderful spots for quiet reflection.

BEACH ACCESS: Private Beach accessed with code provided. Go out the door and to the right towards the pool and then right onto boardwalk. Enter code and then just a few steps till you have toes in the sand.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Bed with Ensuite Bath and Balcony
• Bedroom 2 -- King Bed with Ensuite Bath
• Bedroom 3 -- King Bed with Jack N Jill Bath
• Bedroom 4 -- King Bed with Jack N Jill Bath
• Sleeper sofa in living room (sleeps 2)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Ocean Front with Gulf Views
• Private Beach
• Seasonal Beach Service (2 beach chairs, 1 umbrella Mar -- Oct, at no additional cost)
• Community Pool
• Outdoor Shower
• 2 Bikes
• 4 King Rooms
• Single level living space
• Fireplace in living room
• Outdoor balcony seating
• Outdoor ground floor seating
• Full size washer and dryer
• Smart TVs
• Full linen package
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Self-Check-In

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- There are 2 designated parking spots and 1 on a first come, first serve basis in overflow area.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
